fragments.text: חָרְכָה. מִתְמִימַי פָּרְכָה. וְנִתַּן לָהּ אַרְכָּה: רָחֲבָה וְאָרְכָה. וְקַשְׁתָּהּ דָּרְכָה. וְעֹל הֶאֱרִיכָה: בְּעַתַּתָּהּ בְּרַכָּה. וְהִנֵּה דְרוּכָה. וְעַד עַתָּה מוֹלְכָה: יְסוֹדוֹת עִרְמָה. עֵרָה וְהֶחֱרִימָה. וְעַד יְסוֹד עֵירֹמָה: רֹאשׁ הֵרִימָה. וְסוֹד הֶעֱרִימָה. וַתְּהִי רָמָה: בְּעָרְמָה מַעֲרִימָה. וְעַד שַׁחַק רָמָה. וְתָאֱפוֹד מְלוּכָה: יְרִיעוֹתַי גָּרְדָה. אָהֳלֵי שָׁדְדָה. וְחָרְשָׁה וְשִׂדְּדָה: קַנְיָנוּת רָפְדָה. וּמַלְכוּת אָפְדָה. וְאֶת הִקְפִּידָה: יוֹזְמֵי וּפִרְדָּה. עֲבוֹד

לְזוּ חָרְדָה. וְחִלְּלָה מְלוּכָה: לְהָצוֹת בְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ. וּפָצָה לְעֵין מֶלֶךְ. מִי לִי בָרָק מֶלֶךְ: יָהֲרָה בְּכֵס מֶלֶךְ. זוּלָתִי אֵין מֶלֶךְ. אֲנִי וְאַפְסִי מֶלֶךְ: רָם עַל כָּל־מֶלֶךְ. תַּעֲבִירֶנָּה מִמֶּלֶךְ. וּלְךָ תָּשִׁיב מְלוּכָה:

men and has achieved length of rule. It has expanded greatly, stretched the bow and extended far its yoke. It has frightened the tender people (Israel) and trampled it down, and rules to this day. It has loosened and destroyed the foundation stones of the Temple and laid them bare down to the ground. It has lifted up its head, devised a secret plan and stands there powerfully. It is ablaze with guile, raises itself up to heaven and girds itself in majesty. My tapestries has it torn, destroyed my tabernacles, ploughed and harrowed its site. It has acquired dominion, wrapped itself in might and offended this people (Israel). It initiated rebellion, served idols zealously

and desecrated the realm of God. It oppressed the King’s children (Israel) and said in the sight of the King: “Who is in heaven my king?”. There is boasting from the royal throne: “There is no king besides me, I alone am king”. O Thou who art exalted above all kings, remove from it the rank of king, so that the kingdom may return to Thee.

instructions.text: חתום בראשי חרוזים אלעזר בירבי קליר.

fragments.text: מֶלֶךְ מְמַלֵּט מֵרָעָה. לְיוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה. הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ:
O King, Thou savest from misfortune those who understand Teruah, Holy God.
מֶלֶךְ זוֹכֵר אֲחוּז קֶרֶן. לְתוֹקְעֵי לְךָ הַיּוֹם בְּקֶרֶן. נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ:
O King, Thou dost remember him (Isaac) who was caught by the horn (the ram) on behalf of those who blow the horn before Thee today, O awe-inspiring and Holy One!

אַאֽפִּיר נֶֽזֶר אָיוֹם. בְּשִׁלּוּשׁ קְדֻשַּׁת הַיוֹם: גִּבּוֹרֵי כֹחַ גְּדֻלָּה. דִּדּוּהוּ בְבֵית דִּיגְלָה: חוּג הוֹגֶה הֶמְלָה. וּתְקוֹעֵהוּ בְּהִלּוּל וּמִלָּה: זוֹכֵר לָעַד זָכִיּוֹת. חֲדִישׁוּהוּ זֶמֶר חַיּוֹת: טוֹב עוֹמֵס טָרַח. יְיַחֲדוּהוּ בְּחִדּוּשׁ יֶרַח: כּוֹבֵשׁ כָּל־כְּעָסִים. לְבַל אַף לְהָשִׂים: מְשָׁרְתָיו בְּחִיל מוֹרָא. נִכְחָם הַלְלוּ נוֹרָא: שַׂרְפֵי סְבִיב סַעֲרָה. עֱנוּ לְמַעֲבִיר
עֶבְרָה: פְּלִיאָים פִּצְחוּ פֶה. צִלְצְלוּ הַכֹּל צוֹפֶה: קְהִלּוֹת עַם קְדוֹשִׁים. רוֹמְמוּהוּ רְבָבוֹת רוֹעֲשִׁים: שְׁמֹעַ קוֹל שׁוֹפָר. תַּאֲזִין וְאַשְׁמָה תוּפָר:

I adorn the awe-inspiring with a crown through the threefold sanctification of the day. The strong in might and greatness rejoice before Him in the house of assembly. They who praise in tumultuous throngs, laud Him with glorifying word. To Him who remembers piety for ever, do the Hayoth sing a new song. Praise Him alone — benevolent is He and forgives sins — on the day of the new moon. He suppresses wrath entirely and does not allow anger. O you (the angels) who serve Him in trembling and fear, praise Him who is awe-inspiring in the presence of those (Israel). Angels of fire encircled by the whirlwind, chant in honour of Him who

removes wrath. Angels of mystery, open your mouths to praise Him who sees all. Congregations of the holy people, praise Him, tumultuous myriads. Hearken to the loud blast of the Shofar that guilt may be forgiven.
תְּשַׁלֵּשׁ שׁוֹפָרוֹת בְּהַר הַקֹּדֶשׁ. וַאֲשַׁלֵּשׁ קְדֻשָּׁה בַּקֹּדֶשׁ:
Three times wilt Thou sound the Shofar blast on the holy mountain; three times will I pronounce the sanctification in the Sanctuary.
שִׁבְטֵי מְקוֹרָאֶךָ עֲלֵה וּמְשׁוֹל. נְטִישׁוֹת צָרִים כְּהִתְוִיז לְנַשֵּׁל. כִּי לַיְיָ הַמְּלוּכָה וּמוֹשֵׁל. קָדוֹשׁ:
שְׁבוּתֵנוּ מִמֶּרְחָק עֲלוֹת לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ. וּנְפָאֲרֶנּוּ תָּמִיד בִּדְבִיר מִקְדָּשׁוֹ. כִּי זָכַר אֶת דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ. קָדוֹשׁ:
(כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל וְשׁוֹכְנֵי אָרֶץ. יֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד הִגְדִּיל יְיָ לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּאָרֶץ. וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ. קָדוֹשׁ:)
אֲדָר וָהוֹד אֶתֵּן בְּצִבְיוֹן. שׁוּעַ אֶעֶרְכָה בְּנִיב וְהִגָּיוֹן.
אֶקְרָא לֵאלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן:
בְּיוֹם הַנִּבְחָר מִשְּׁמֵי עָרִיץ. מֵישָׁרִים לִשְׁפֹּט קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ לְהַעֲרִיץ.
יְיָ מָלָךְ תָּגֵל הָאָרֶץ:
גֵּאוּתוֹ גָּדְלָה עוֹלָם מֵהָכִיל. עֱזוּזוֹ לְסַפֵּר כֹּחַ מִי יָכִיל.
מֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל:
דַּע יִשְׁמוּ כָּל בְּרִיוֹתָיו. וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי גָדְלוּ גְּבוּרוֹתָיו.
זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו:
הִצִּיב וְיָדָה אֶבֶן פִּנָּתוֹ. נַחֲלִיאֵל עֲבוּר לְשַׁעֲשֵׁעַ בְּאֻמָּתוֹ.
יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:
וְרָשַׁם בְּחֹק דַּת הֶגְיוֹנִי. בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה לִפְקוֹד זִכְרוֹנִי. לְזִכָּרוֹן בְּהֵיכַל יְיָ

זֶבַח קֹדֶשׁ כְּהֻכְשַׁר אָז בְּעֵינָיו. רֶגֶל תְּמוּרָתוֹ אַיִל לְהַקְרִיב לְפָנָיו. אַחַר נֶאֱחַז בַּסְּבַךְ בְּקַרְנָיו: חִנֵּם חֲנִיטָיו לִתְקוֹעַ בְּזֶה חֹדֶשׁ. יוֹם זֶה אִם יִקְרֶה בְּשַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ. זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ: טִבְעוֹן אִם בְּחֹל יְבֹאָכֶם. צַוּוּ לִתְקוֹעַ בְּכָל גְּבוּלְכֶם. יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם:
יָרוּם צוּר יִשְׁעִי פִּי כָל־אֻמִּים. חֲשׂוֹף זְרוֹעֲךָ לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִמִּתְקוֹמְמִים.
מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל עוֹלָמִים:
כְּהִגָּלוֹתְךָ לְעֵין כֹּל שְׁכִינָה לְהוֹעֵד. קְהִלּוֹת וְרִבְבוֹת בְּנִימוֹ לְהָעֵד.
יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
לְךָ יָאֲתָה כָּבוֹד
וְעֹז הַגּוֹיִם. חֶלֶד וְכָל שׁוֹכְנֶיהָ וְכָל הָאִיִּים.
מִי לֹא יִרָאֲךָ מֶלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם:
מוֹטַת צָרִים שְׁבֹר וְהַכְחִידֵם. וּדְחוּיֶיךָ קַבֵּץ וְחִנָּם תִּפְדֵּם.
זְכוֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶדֶם:
נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים נַחֲמוּ בְּכִפְלַיִם. קָמֵיהֶם עַל פָּנֵימוֹ גַּלֵּה שׁוּלַיִם.
זְכֹר יְיָ לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלָיִם:
סְלִיל מְסִלָּתֵנוּ יַשֵּׁר לְצַעַד. וּבֵין יְקִירָה קַרְסֹל לֹא יִמְעַד. כִּנְאֻמַת זָכוֹר אֶזְכְּרֶנּוּ עוֹד:
קִרְיַת מְשׂוֹשׂ הֵיכָל וְאוּלָם. מִזְבֵּחַ יָשִׁיב וּכְלֵי שָׁרֵת כֻּלָּם. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם: שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יְרַנְּנוּ לִשְׁמוֹ. יְעָרוֹת יִמְחֲאוּ כַף לְהַנְעִימוֹ.
כִּי פָקַד יְיָ אֶת עַמּוֹ:
תֹּקֶף אֶרְאֶלִּים וְכוֹכְבֵי צָפֶר. תְּהִלּוֹת יִתְּנוּ שֶׁבַח לְהַשְׁפִּיר.
הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר:
(כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל וְשׁוֹכְנֵי אָרֶץ. יֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד הִגְדִּיל יְיָ לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּאָרֶץ. וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ. קָדוֹשׁ:)
יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וּלְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים. הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ:
וְהוּא בְאֶחָד וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ. וְנַפְשׁוֹ אִוְּתָה וַיָּעַשׂ.
נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ:
Let the tribes of those Thou hast called, arise and rule, cut off the branches of enemies and let them fall, for both kingdom and ruler belong to the Lord, the Holy One.
May our exiled ascend from afar His holy mountain that we may praise Him always in His Inner Sanctuary, for He has remembered His holy word, the Holy One.
All inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth do constantly say: Great things has the Lord performed on earth, and the Lord shall be King over all the earth, the Holy One.
Glorification and praise willingly do I bestow, I order prayer in speech and thought,
I call upon the supreme God.
On the day chosen from the mighty heavens for upright judgment to glorify His holiness,
the Lord rules, the earth rejoices.
The world is too small to contain His loftiness, who is there able to describe His might?
King of all the earth is God, then sing with understanding.
May all His creatures acquire perception and know how great is His might.
A memorial has He established for His wonders.
He has firmly planted His foundation stone (Torah), the divine gift, so as to rejoice in His people.
He remembers His covenant for ever.
He has inscribed my thoughts through a statute of the faith so as to remember me year by year, for a remembrance in the sanctuary of the Lord.

When the holy sacrifice (Isaac) once found favour in His eyes, He allowed a ram to be sacrificed in his stead, which was later caught with his horns in the thicket. He taught the descendants of (Isaac) to blow the Shofar on this new moon; but if this day falls on a Sabbath, then the mere mention of Teruah is a sacred proclamation. When it falls on a weekday for you, let it be blown in all your regions, let it be a day of Teruah for you.
Exalted is the rock of my salvation in the mouths of all peoples. Expose Thine arm to help us against adversaries,
Thy realm is a realm of all eternity.
When Thou revealest Thyself before all eyes to visit once again Thy dwelling place, congregations in their myriads will proclaim aloud:
The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
Becoming to Thee is honour and the acknowledgment of might pronounced by the earth and its inhabitants and all the isles:
who does not fear Thee, King of the nations.
Break the yoke of adversaries, destroy them; gather those dispersed by Thee and redeem them without ransom.
Remember Thy congregation which Thou hast once chosen.
Comfort the noblest of peoples, expose to their faces the shame of those who rise against them;
remember, O Lord, against the sons of Edom the day of Jerusalem.
Make even our highway, straighten it for our steps that the foot of Thy favourite may not stumble, as Thou hast said: I will surely still remember him.

The joyful city, sanctum and porch, and the altar may He restore with all the sacred vessels; the Lord will reign for ever. Heaven and earth exult at His Name; forests clap their hands in delight in Him;
for the Lord has considered His people.
The mighty Erelim and the bright stars in glory will proclaim His praise.
Praise Him with the Shofar blast.
(All the inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth do constantly say: Great things has the Lord performed on earth, and the Lord shall be King over all the earth, the Holy One.)
He judges the world in justice and nations in righteousness, God is holy.
He is unique, who can reply to Him? Whatever His soul desires, He accomplishes,
Awe-inspiring and Holy!

אֶתֵּן לְפוֹעֲלִי צֶדֶק. בְּיוֹם הֻנְבָּחַר מַעַשׂ לְהַבְדֵּק: גֵּאוּתוֹ מְאֹד נַעֲלָה. דֶּרֶךְ עַנְוְתוֹ לְפִי הַגְּדֻלָּה: הוּא אָדוֹן הָעוֹלָם. וּמִי הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלָם: זוֹכֵר הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֹם. חוֹנֵן וְעוֹשֶׂה דִין יָתוֹם: טָהוֹר מָרוֹם וְנִשָּׂא. יָפֶה בְעִתּוֹ הַכֹּל עָשָׂה: כַּבִּיר לֹא יִמְאַס לְנִבְזֶה בְּעֵינָיו נִמְאָס: מְפֹאָר רוֹכֵב עֲרָבוֹת. נֹגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ וְאֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת: סוֹעֵף בְּחַרְבוֹת שְׁנוּנוֹת. עֲבוּר יְתוֹמִים וְאַלְמָנוֹת: פֹּעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֵּם. צוּר פֶּה וּמֵשִׂים אִלֵּם: קוֹנֵה הַכֹּל בְּרַחֲמִים. רָם וּמַשְׁפִּיל רָמִים: שׁוֹפֵט יְצוּרָיו בַּחֲנִינָה. תָּמִים פֹּעַל אֵל אֱמוּנָה: שׁוֹפְטֵי אֶרֶץ תֹּהוּ. פַּחֲדוֹ יִבָּהֲלוּ וְיִתְמָהוּ: עוֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ. וּתְחִלָּה מַקְדִּימָם מִפְּנֵי זַעְמוֹ: נְדִיבִים בְּדִקְדוּקָם יָחִילוּ. כַּאֲשֶׁר מִשְׁפָּטוֹ פָעָלוּ: רוֹאֶה כָל־תַעֲלוּמוֹת. יוֹשֵׁב בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמוֹת: צוֹפֶה כָל נוֹלְדוֹת. חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל הָעֲתִידוֹת: קוֹרֵא הַדּוֹרוֹת מֵרֹאשׁ. חִקְרֵי לֵב לָתוּר וְלִדְרוֹשׁ: זוֹכֵר בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים. קַיֵּם שְׁבוּעָה לְאַחֲרוֹנִים:

I praise the justice of my Creator on the day appointed for the examination of deeds. His majesty is great, but the way of His humility accords with His greatness. He is Lord of the world, who can resist Him and remain unharmed? He remembers the man who walks in uprightness, and graciously promotes the cause of the orphan. Pure, lofty and exalted, He has made everything harmoniously in its time. Although Almighty, He does not reject the man who in his own eyes is despised and rejected. Glorified, riding above the clouds, radiance is in front of Him and blazing fire. He rages with sharp swords on behalf of orphans and widows. He requites man according to his work. He shapes the mouth and also makes it dumb. Owner of all in compassion, He is lofty and lowers the lofty. He judges His creatures with clemency, perfect in action, God of faithfulness. Earthly judges are as nought, they are frightened through dread of Him and perplexed. He executes the judgment of His people, warning them first of His wrath. Noble ones tremble at the thought of their judgment, as to whether they have accomplished His law. He sees all that are hidden, He dwells in the loftiest heights. He perceives all that is happening, He explores all that is about to come. He summons the generations from the very beginning in order to search out and discover the thoughts of their hearts. O Thou who dost remember the covenant with those who came first, fulfil the promise to those who come last.
יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק. וּלְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים. הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ:
He judges the world in justice and nations in righteousness, God is holy.
תָּעִיר וְתָרִיעַ. לְהַכְרִית כָּל מֵרֵעַ. וְתִקָּדֵשׁ בְּיוֹדְעֵי לְהָרִיעַ. קָדוֹשׁ:
Thou dost rise and let the trumpet sound to destroy every evil doer, and Thou art sanctified by those who know how to sound the Teruah, Holy One.
מֶלֶךְ זוֹכֵר אֲחוּז קֶרֶן. לְתוֹקְעֵי לְךָ הַיּוֹם בְּקֶרֶן. נוֹרָא וְקָדוֹשׁ:
O King, Thou dost remember him (Isaac) who was caught by the horn (the ram) on behalf of those who blow the horn before Thee today, O Awe-inspiring and Holy One.
